hypothesis: Negative Treasury ETF price pressure from month-end liquidity selling reverses during the three sessions immediately before month end.

academic_rule_mapping.source: Etula, Rinne, Suominen and Vaittinen (2020), Dash for Cash, Review of Financial Studies 33(1)
academic_rule_mapping.T: last observed session of calendar month
academic_rule_mapping.entry: open(T-3), known after completed T-4 close
academic_rule_mapping.note: No threshold, Friday filter, auction filter or timing variant is optimized.

current_structure_caveat: Treasury settlement was already short in the paper; ETF and equity settlement conventions have since changed. OOS 2024 is required but contains only part of the post-May-2024 U.S. T+1 regime.
data_reuse_disclosure: The same 2016-2024 price files were previously consumed by a rejected 12-month momentum family. This test is preregistered before its own signals or returns, but is not a fresh-data independent confirmation.
